papers.title: Steering Equilibrium Selection in Regularized Self-Play via the Reference Policy
papers.titleZh: 通过参考策略引导正则化自博弈中的均衡选择
papers.abstract: Regularized self-play -- the family behind DeepNash's Stratego play -- drives a two-player zero-sum policy to a Nash equilibrium by best-responding to a slowly moving, entropy-regularized reference policy $ρ$. When the game has a polytope of value-equivalent equilibria, the regularizer silently breaks the tie: with a uniform reference it selects the maximum-entropy member, the I-projection of $ρ$ onto the Nash set. Can the reference be used to choose the equilibrium on purpose? On five exactly solvable games plus a 2-D polytope, with exact best responses and equivalence tests over independent seeds, anchoring the reference at a target member and refining steers self-play to that member with mean coordinate error 0.007 at median exploitability $5\times10^{-5}$, TOST-equivalent to the request within $\pm0.05$; the anchoring persists through refinement and follows the reference, not the initialization. Selection follows the reach-weighted I-projection (slope 0.969 [0.950, 0.987]). We report with equal emphasis where the story breaks: fixed off-manifold references cost 0.08-0.25 exploitability; stiff or flat families require a smaller mirror step, set by a pre-registered rule; boundary targets undershoot; curvature predicts where boundary saturation bites (rank correlation 0.90, p=0.037) while interior precision is curvature-independent. Table and MLP steering maps are equivalent within $\pm0.03$ at every target (30 seeds); matched control arms show attention's robust signature is excess seed variance, any systematic shift bounded at 0.018 and not significant. Against a best response the selection-robustness trade-off is degenerate: steering matters only against fixed, non-equilibrium opponents. The recipe -- anchor the reference at the desired member and refine -- reinterprets the KL anchor of RLHF-style RL as a selection knob, not only a stability leash.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在零和博弈中，当存在多个价值等价的纳什均衡时，学习算法最终收敛到哪一个成为关键问题。传统正则化自博弈默认选择最大熵均衡，但尚不清楚是否能主动控制这一选择过程，以及神经网络架构是否会干扰该机制。本文探究能否通过设计参考策略来有目的地引导均衡选择。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究基于正则化自博弈框架，其中策略更新受一个缓慢演化的参考策略驱动，并通过KL散度正则项拉近当前策略。在多个具有解析解的博弈（如Kuhn扑克）中，明确设定纳什均衡流形结构，利用精确的最佳响应和已知的均衡集合，测试不同参考策略对收敛点的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 实验证明，将参考策略锚定在目标均衡上并进行标准优化，可高精度引导学习轨迹到达该成员，平均坐标误差仅0.007，且等价性检验确认结果与目标无显著差异。所选均衡近似等于参考策略在可达权重下的信息投影，验证了可控性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 采用闭式可解的小规模博弈作为实验平台，结合精确的树遍历计算反事实值与最佳响应。通过多随机种子重复实验，使用Bootstrap置信区间、TOST等价性检验和非参数假设检验量化结果稳定性与统计显著性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果受限于小规模游戏与精确梯度设定，在平坦或刚性较强的均衡族上可能出现收敛偏差或边界饱和现象。尽管如此，论文清晰展示了参考策略作为均衡选择旋钮的有效性，对理解RLHF、TRPO等含KL锚点的算法具有启发意义，值得细读其方法设计与实证逻辑。

papers.title: Mutual Evaluation and Supervision without Peers
papers.titleZh: 无同行的相互评估与监督
papers.abstract: This article introduces mutual evaluation of a replicable task worker and a critic that incentivizes truthful reporting, both modeled as strategic agents. The critic chooses a finite-valued rule that induces an evaluation score on joint report laws. Their common payoff is analyzed through regret relative to the unrestricted critic envelope. The critic rule is distinct from the evaluation score. This class enables a peer-free information elicitation mechanism using conditionally independent replications of a worker on the same task. This replication-loop mechanism implements a type-agreement payoff using same-task replications and new-task samples. In contrast to the peer-prediction and scoring-rule literature, implementations are shown that produce unbiased Pearson and Shannon information scores without requiring peers, a ground-truth reference, or likelihood-ratio estimation. A valid binary critic also can be represented by shared finite type annotations of worker returns. One runtime restriction is that the number of required replicas is random and can depend on the critic rule. Other timing effects, such as commitment and reoptimization, yield distinct incentives, connecting the framework to variational peer prediction. This mechanism class illustrates why strategic considerations matter for both critic and worker agents.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统同行预测机制依赖其他工人的报告来激励真实反馈，而评分规则则依赖可观测的真实结果。本文提出一个根本性问题：能否在既无同行报告也无真实结果的情况下，仍激励工人如实完成任务？现有方法受限于对同伴或未来观测的依赖，本文旨在构建一种不依赖这些外部参照的信息激励机制，尤其适用于无法获取地面实况或部署多个独立工人的场景。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑两个战略代理——一个可复制的任务执行者（worker）和一个评估者（critic），共享同一任务与回报类型。worker通过信道生成报告，critic选择一个有限值的判定规则来比较报告间的相似性。关键设定是允许对同一任务进行多次独立复制，并利用相同任务与新任务样本之间的对比来构造评估信号。机制基于等待时间统计量，将评估得分从判定规则中分离出来。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了‘复制环’机制，首次实现了无需同行、无需真实结果即可无偏估计Pearson和Shannon互信息。证明了当worker如实报告且critic的标注保留全部任务信息时，双方共同最大化期望得分并构成纳什均衡。同时揭示了critic的注解选择直接影响信息损失与运行成本，且最优critic可通过合并不影响任务信念的报告来压缩标注空间。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心技术依赖于逆二项抽样与等待时间恒等式，将几何分布的命中时间转化为信息量的无偏估计。通过定义‘critic包络’与‘遗憾’分析激励相容性，结合条件独立复制与新鲜任务采样构造偏差对照。证明路径利用信息论恒等式将期望支付映射到互信息函数，并借助等价类划分刻画有效评估结构。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 机制要求固定的无记忆策略，且所需复制次数为随机甚至可能无界，实际效率受方差影响较大。虽然理论上摆脱了对同行和真实结果的依赖，但依赖精确复制假设，在异构系统中难以实现。最值得阅读的是其新颖的机制抽象方式与对评估者战略角色的显式建模，为AI评测提供了脱离人类标注的新范式。

papers.title: Learning Principal-Agent Contracts for Equitable Smallholder Carbon Farming under Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection
papers.titleZh: 基于主从合约学习实现道德风险与逆向选择下小农户碳农业的公平参与
papers.abstract: Agricultural soils are a major untapped carbon sink. Carbon farming is emerging as a promising practice for tapping this potential. Smallholder farmers, who dominate agriculture across South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, are key to scaling climate mitigation via carbon farming. It is ironic that real-world carbon programs largely fail to reach them. We study this important gap through the lens of contract design. An aggregator offers a single pooled contract to a heterogeneous population of smallholder farmers who have private adoption costs (adverse selection) and exert unobserved effort (moral hazard), with agronomic outcomes evolving over multiple seasons. We formulate this evolving contracting problem as a POMDP and use reinforcement learning to learn a dynamic profit-maximising contract. We analyse the performance of the aggregator under various conditions. We find that a profit-maximising aggregator does not merely inherit the exclusion of smallholders, it amplifies it. On large farms the aggregator realises 87.7% of achievable adoption, against only 8.2% on smallholdings. Per-hectare Measurement, Reporting and Verification (MRV) costs fall as farm size rises, and the aggregator's pooling contract compounds this gradient rather than offsetting it. A counterfactual that makes MRV costs purely area-proportional eliminates this disparity. Our results and simulation can guide contract and policy design that opens carbon income to smallholders while enabling agricultural soils to contribute to climate mitigation at scale.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么现有碳农业项目难以惠及小农户？本文指出，尽管小农户在全球农业中占主导地位并拥有巨大固碳潜力，但由于信息不对称（如私人成本）、努力不可观测、测量报告验证（MRV）固定成本等因素，商业聚合商倾向于排除小规模农场。这不仅是一个实践难题，更反映了利润驱动合约在结构性偏见上的放大效应。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者构建了一个多季节主从博弈模型，其中聚合商作为主导者提供单一池化合约，异质性小农户作为跟随者决定是否采纳及投入多少努力。模型融合了逆向选择（私有采用成本）、道德风险（隐藏努力）、土壤有机碳动态演化与MRV成本结构，将问题建模为一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），从而捕捉长期动态与信息摩擦的交互影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 研究发现，利润最大化的聚合商并非被动接受小农户参与门槛，而是主动加剧了其排斥——大型农场实现了87.7%的潜在采纳率，而小农户仅为8.2%。这种差距不能仅由MRV成本解释，而是源于池化合约下边际激励与存量成本之间的权衡。引入‘实际采纳份额’（RAS）指标揭示了该放大的不平等机制。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用深度强化学习（TQC算法）训练聚合商策略，在模拟环境中学习动态最优合约。通过对比第一优福利基准与多种消融设置（有无道德风险、逆向选择、农场规模异质性），分离出各因素对绩效的影响。特别地，利用反事实分析测试MRV成本重新分配政策的效果，展示了框架作为政策评估工具的能力。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设农民短视响应且无信贷约束，可能低估现实中小农户面临的多重障碍；同时未考虑可加性约束与永久性要求，使结果偏向乐观。然而，该文的价值在于其系统性整合了农业经济学与AI机制设计，提供了可配置开源仿真平台，适合关注公平市场设计、AI for Social Good 和可持续发展机制的研究者深入阅读其模型抽象与政策推演部分。

papers.title: Exact Regret Frontiers and Externality Scheduling in Centralized Serial-Dictatorship Bandits
papers.titleZh: 中心化序列独裁带臂中的精确遗憾前沿与外部性调度
papers.abstract: Exploration in centralized serial-dictatorship matching bandits must use complete matchings, so learning one player--arm pair can impose regret on others. We study this externality under a known common priority order and Gaussian rewards with unit variance. We show that the matching-level Graves--Lai constraints reduce to finitely many pairwise exploration quotas and, at top-choice-separated instances, yield a polynomial-size marginal linear program. At these instances, the exact attainable set of expected logarithmic regret coefficients is $G(θ)\Xset(θ)$, where $\Xset$ is the feasible matching-allocation set and $G$ maps allocations to player regret. The usual upper-closed Graves--Lai region can be strictly larger despite having the same Pareto-minimal boundary. We further show that identical exploration quotas can induce very different regret through their scheduling. Finally, we construct estimate--solve--track policies, uniformly good on the full row-strict class, that attain every fixed positively weighted optimum without assuming optimizer uniqueness. Every Pareto-minimal point is pointwise attainable, possibly through an instance-calibrated target.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在中心化匹配平台中，探索一个玩家-臂对可能迫使其他玩家离开其稳定匹配臂，从而产生跨玩家的学习外部性。本文关注的问题是：在已知共同优先级顺序下，不同玩家的渐近遗憾系数向量哪些是可通过良好策略实现的？这揭示了信息获取与代价分配之间的分离，挑战了传统认为最优总遗憾即可刻画性能的认知。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑N个玩家与K个臂，在每轮由平台选择完整匹配并观察高斯奖励。玩家遵循序列独裁规则形成稳定匹配，平台需通过完整匹配进行探索。关键设定是学习必须使用完整匹配，导致探索某一配对会干扰他人，从而引发外部性。目标是刻画所有可实现的玩家个体遗憾系数向量。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了信息约束可简化为有限个成对探索额度，并在‘首选分离’实例上将优化问题转化为多项式大小的边缘线性规划。核心结果是精确刻画了可实现的遗憾区域为G(0)X(0)，其中每个帕累托最小点均可被实现，且通常的上闭Graves-Lai区域虽边界相同但可能更大。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者结合信息论与调度几何分析：利用Graves-Lai框架导出匹配层级的信息约束，并将其等价转化为成对额度条件；再通过边缘变量投影将指数级匹配调度问题降维为多项式规模的线性规划；最后构造‘估计-求解-跟踪’类策略来实现任意边界点。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于高斯奖励与首选分离等较强假设，且策略的有限时域表现受制于认证开销。尽管如此，论文的价值在于首次明确分离了学习成本与代价分配机制，揭示了调度策略如何决定遗憾分布，其额度-调度二分法对理解多主体探索外部性具有深刻启示。

papers.title: Anonymous Accountability
papers.abstract: We ask how an expert panel should disclose auditable conflicts of interest when reports are named and experts care about their reputations for ability. Before sealed binary assessments are filed, an auditor commits to disclosing no orientation information, each named expert's orientation, or only the number of experts oriented in each direction; disclosure occurs after reports are locked. Holding reporting behaviour fixed, composition disclosure and individual attribution are exactly Blackwell-equivalent for learning the state at every finite panel size. Conditional on named reports remaining public, composition is minimal among state-lossless disclosures of orientations: every lossless public message must make the composition recoverable together with the reports. Incentives nevertheless differ sharply. In the large-panel limit near pooling, the local career returns to following evidence against one's orientation under attribution, secrecy, and composition disclosure stand in the ratio 1:4:5. On an open set of parameters, the two extreme regimes have only pooling within symmetric cutoff strategies, while composition disclosure admits a tremble-robust informative equilibrium. Near the lower boundary of this region, a sequence of composition equilibria is sparse---the evidence-following rate is of order 1/N---yet induces a nondegenerate state experiment. Anonymous disclosure can therefore preserve the information available under attribution while creating stronger incentives to produce it.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当专家因利益关联而可能偏袒时，如何披露其利益冲突才能既保持问责又鼓励说真话？完全公开会让人找借口推责，完全保密则无法解读报告。本文研究介于两者之间的‘匿名披露’：公布持不同立场的专家人数，但不指明谁是谁。这触及透明度政策的核心矛盾——既要让公众理解集体意见，又要防止个体被豁免责任。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型包含多名命名专家，每人拥有隐藏能力水平，观察到信号并知晓自身利益倾向（如资助方偏好）。他们提交不可撤销的公开报告，事后状态揭晓并更新其声誉。审计方承诺在报告锁定后披露三种信息之一：无披露、全披露（谁持何立场）、或仅披露各立场人数。专家权衡说真话带来的声誉收益与违背倾向的私人成本，采用对称单调策略决定是否遵从证据。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现，在任意固定报告行为下，仅披露构成人数与全披露在推断真实状态方面信息等价，且是最小充分统计量。然而激励效果截然不同：大样本下，遵循证据的局部职业回报在全披露、无披露与构成交付下的比例为1:4:5。在一定参数范围内，前两种制度只能产生沉默均衡，而构成交付能支持一个稀疏但稳健的信息性均衡。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过计算不同披露制度下的声誉更新函数来比较激励，并利用Blackwell信息序和Le Cam缺陷度量证明信息等价性。关键技巧是将联合后验分解为可观测量的函数，进而构造状态无关的随机核实现相互粗化。对于大样本分析，采用泊松近似处理稀疏偏离，并通过统一收敛论证连接有限与极限结果。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型依赖对称性、二元状态与独立信号等强假设，机制有效性也集中于特定参数区域。尽管如此，其核心洞见——分离‘解读面板’与‘归责个人’的功能——具有广泛启发性。最值得读的是其清晰的模型抽象、精确的信息-激励分离定理，以及关于‘少披露反而更强激励’的反直觉机制，对科学咨询、投资决策等场景的设计有深远启示。

papers.title: Mitigating Retaliatory Algorithmic Collusion in Repeated Games
papers.titleZh: 缓解重复博弈中的报复性算法共谋
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning agents trained to maximize their own reward in repeated interactions can converge to supra-competitive outcomes resembling explicit collusion, without communication or shared design. Existing mitigation approaches are largely tied to specific economic settings, like two-sided platforms and auctions, leaving open how to design interventions for general repeated games. We address this gap by formalizing the connection between empirical observations from prior work on Q-learning collusion and classical theory of Simple Penal Codes (SPCs). We show any non-trivial SPC induces a quantifiable conditional dependence in agents' policies, detectable via the total variation distance between an agent's action distributions across cooperation and defection histories. Building on this connection, we propose CURB (Collusion Unwinding via Reward shaping and Belief injection), a reward-shaping framework that penalizes this Total Variation (TV) distance signal during Q-learning and is guaranteed to convert any SPC fixed point of the dynamics into a trivial one, thus precluding collusive equilibria sustained by punishment threats. Empirically, CURB substantially reduces collusion by Q-learning agents in both Bertrand and Cournot Competition Repeated Games. We further demonstrate that CURB extends to deep Q-network agents in Bertrand competition, suggesting the mechanism generalizes beyond tabular Q-learning.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么强化学习智能体在重复互动中会自发形成类似价格共谋的行为？现有干预方法多依赖特定市场结构或调整探索率等超参数，难以推广到一般重复博弈。本文关注的核心问题是：驱动共谋的惩罚威胁机制本质上是什么，以及如何从博弈论均衡结构出发，设计出通用且可证明有效的干预手段来瓦解这种行为。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究了两个经典寡头竞争模型——伯特兰德价格竞争与古诺产量竞争，在表格型Q学习和深度Q网络（DQN）两种设置下进行实验。输入是对手的历史动作序列，输出为当前动作选择。通过引入‘共谋指数’衡量行为偏离纳什均衡的程度，并结合奖励塑形与信念注入机制，评估所提方法在抑制共谋方面的有效性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文的主要贡献在于建立了算法共谋与经典博弈论中简单惩罚码（SPC）之间的形式化联系，并提出CURB框架，理论上证明其能消除由惩罚威胁维持的共谋均衡。实验结果显示，CURB在多种环境下均显著降低共谋指数至接近零水平，效果优于平台级干预和不完美监控等基线方法，验证了该机制的普适性和有效性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: CURB方法的关键在于识别并削弱智能体策略中的条件依赖性。它利用总变差距离（TV）量化一个智能体在对手合作与背叛历史下的行动分布差异，作为潜在惩罚行为的信号。通过在奖励中对此TV值施加惩罚，使执行报复变得代价高昂，从而破坏共谋所需的威胁可信度，最终迫使系统收敛到非共谋的平凡均衡。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 理论保证目前仅适用于两智能体情形，且信念注入部分缺乏形式化分析。此外，方法依赖于对‘背叛’的合理定义，可能在复杂策略空间中面临挑战。尽管如此，本文最值得阅读的是其将经典博弈理论与现代强化学习结合的问题抽象方式，以及基于均衡结构设计干预机制的设计思想，为治理算法共谋提供了新范式。

papers.title: Refuse, Decompose, Refresh: A Claim-Safe Protocol for Closed-Loop AI Evaluation
papers.titleZh: 拒绝、分解、刷新：一种声明安全的闭环AI评估协议
papers.abstract: An AI evaluation can be perfectly reproducible and still support the wrong claim. This risk is acute in closed-loop systems: policy determines visited states, observable components, and which failures leave a measurable trace. We propose a claim-safe protocol with three actions. Refuse: abstain when a clean reference stream or matched runtime comparison lacks support. Decompose: report protocol execution, operational false admission, and structural hypotheses separately rather than as one PASS/FAIL label. Refresh: treat distribution-shift alarms as requests to invalidate and recompute a reference map, not as fault evidence. We instantiate the protocol in an aggregate-only simulator with 24 policy components, three demand regimes, two fault-mask families, and independent development and heldout seeds. The preregistered heldout contains 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows. Only 55/72 regime-component units were reference-admitted and 54/55 remained runtime-admitted, making abstention part of the result. Stable false admission was 0/20 represented components, with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391 under a frozen 0.20 rule. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic outpredicted nominal fault-cell fraction: across 540 unit-arm rows nested in 20 component clusters, the cell-minus-traffic negative-log-likelihood difference was 0.1264 nats per row, with a 95% component-cluster interval of [0.0593, 0.1918]. A drift log shows why "null" must be reference-relative: clean fault-null streams triggered 15/15, 0/15, and 14/15 alarms across three regimes, while only the middle regime matched the frozen detector reference. Rather than a universal threshold, we contribute an executable contract linking observable support, statistical calibration, and justified claims.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有AI评估常因构造效度缺失而得出误导性结论，尤其在闭环系统中问题更严重：被评估策略自身决定观测状态，导致某些故障无法留下可观测痕迹。传统打分制将复杂判断压缩为单一标量，忽视证据支持度差异。本文指出，精确可复现的分数仍可能支撑错误主张，核心瓶颈在于缺乏对‘何时可评估’的明确定义。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在一个仅通过聚合轨迹观察的闭环目标策略模拟器中展开，包含24个独立组件、三种需求模式及两类反事实故障掩码。评估不依赖个体行为，而是基于清洁参考流与当前运行流的分区支持情况判断可比性，并在满足条件后检测干预信号。实验采用预注册的独立留出集，涵盖1440个案例，严格分离开发与验证过程。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出‘拒绝-分解-刷新’三步协议，使评估成为可执行的声明合同而非排行榜。结果显示仅55/72单位通过初始证据门控，最终54单位进入检测；虚假接纳率上界为0.1391，低于预设容忍阈值。关键发现是‘受影响清洁流量’比‘单元修改比例’更能预测检测效果，且干净数据未必构成检测器零假设。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法围绕三个动词构建：拒绝指在清洁或运行流缺乏共同支持时主动放弃评分；分解要求将执行完整性、操作安全性、覆盖率与结构假设分开报告；刷新则将分布偏移警报视为参考图谱失效请求而非直接故障证据。该协议通过双门控机制确保比较基础，独立校准误报边界，并用嵌套Bootstrap提供聚类置信区间。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论局限于特定模拟器设定，阈值不可直接迁移，且未验证漂移检测器本身的敏感性。家族充分性结果依赖约20个组件集群，可能存在有限聚类下覆盖风险。最值得阅读的是其评估哲学与协议设计，尤其是如何将‘不可评估’显式纳入结果体系，这对高风险系统的监控、审计与安全测试具有启发意义。

papers.title: SCGFM-ART: Amortized Relational Transport for Structure-Centric Graph Foundation Models
papers.titleZh: SCGFM-ART: 面向结构中心图基础模型的摊销关系传输
papers.abstract: Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across severely heterogeneous graph domains. However, severe domain shifts in topology, graph scale, and feature semantics impede the construction of a unified, domain-agnostic representation space. To address this, we propose SCGFM-ART, a structure-centric GFM framework that aligns arbitrary graphs onto a shared relational atlas via Amortized Relational Transport (ART). The relational atlas serves as a universal coordinate system defined by a finite set of relational landmarks (bases), while ART directly predicts reusable, end-to-end graph-to-base transport plans, bypassing costly runtime Gromov-Wasserstein optimizations. Under this formulation, SCGFM-ART decomposes a graph into a unified representation: globally via its relational response coordinates relative to the atlas, and locally via its node-to-role structural correspondences. These correspondences project disparate node attributes into a canonical role space, resolving structural and semantic heterogeneity within a singular alignment interface. Rigorously modeling graphs and atlas bases as finite measured relational spaces, we establish coordinate fidelity bounds, prove stability under predicted transport plans, and derive an amortized coverage bound that guarantees our learning objective tightly surrogates ideal relational coverage. Benchmarked across 14 cross-domain graph- and node-level classification tasks, SCGFM-ART achieves state-of-the-art transferability, securing superior average ranks of 2.29 and 1.14, respectively. Topological perturbation analyses demonstrate that node-role transport retains fine-grained structural nuances beyond global coordinates. On real-world benchmarks, the amortized formulation yields 44.2 to 85.1 times faster frozen target-domain inference by avoiding iterative alignment at test time.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 图基础模型旨在从异构图数据中学习可迁移的通用结构知识，但不同图在拓扑、规模和特征语义上的巨大差异导致难以建立统一的表示空间。现有方法依赖逐样本的复杂优化（如Gromov-Wasserstein距离）进行对齐，计算成本高昂，阻碍了高效推理。本文核心问题是：能否构建一个既能统一处理结构与语义异质性，又能避免运行时重复优化的图基础模型框架？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究在无监督预训练下学习一个共享的关系图谱（relational atlas），并将任意输入图映射到该图谱上。输入是原始图结构，输出是其在图谱中的全局坐标及节点到角色的细粒度对应关系。通过摊销关系传输（ART）直接预测图到图谱基的传输计划，并在14个跨域图与节点分类任务上评估零样本迁移性能，使用准确率和推理速度作为主要指标。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出SCGFM-ART框架，首次将摊销机制引入图基础模型的关系对齐过程，实现了端到端的快速映射。在14项跨域任务中达到最先进水平，平均排名分别为2.29和1.14。关键结果表明，该方法不仅保持高精度，还将冻结目标域推理速度提升44.2至85.1倍，验证了摊销对齐的有效性与实用性，改变了以往必须依赖迭代优化的认知。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是构建一个由可学习关系基组成的共享图谱，并通过神经网络直接预测输入图与各基之间的最优传输耦合（即ART模块）。利用缩放点积与Sinkhorn投影生成满足边际约束的耦合矩阵，并基于此计算关系能量形成全局坐标。理论证明了该摊销目标能紧致地代理理想对齐，确保学习有效性，从而绕开昂贵的逐样本优化。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 尽管性能优越，但其优势高度依赖预定义的图谱容量（K, M），且在结构信号较弱的数据上增益可能受限。实验主要聚焦于分类任务，未涵盖生成或强化学习场景。最值得阅读的是其将最优传输摊销化的创新思路、严谨的理论边界分析，以及在真实世界大规模图上展现的巨大效率提升，为高效图基础模型提供了新范式。

papers.title: Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations
papers.titleZh: GPT 模型中的伤害清洗：安全训练代际间性别歧视被转化而非减少的证据
papers.abstract: Safety evaluations for large language models rely on surface-form classifiers that report declining harm scores across model generations. We provide evidence that this methodology is systematically incomplete: explicit discriminatory content is transformed rather than removed. We call this \emph{harm laundering}. Analysing 450,000 gender-directed completions across 15 models spanning GPT-2 through to GPT-5 (OpenAI GPT lineage; three demographic conditions), we show that sexual violence clusters prevalent in GPT-2 women-directed output disappear by GPT-4, while men-directed completions gain positive representational territory (caregiving, emotional range, ally identity) that women-directed completions do not. The pattern is most visible at GPT-5: Topic~5 (1,997~documents) frames breast cancer as a men's rights debate, while zero equivalent clusters appear in women-directed output. Three independent classifiers score this content as non-toxic. Sentiment scores invert at GPT-4: early models demean women; later models over-correct. Topic diversity in women-directed completions falls 36\% relative to men at the GPT-4 alignment boundary (W/M~$= 0.58$, from $0.91$ at GPT-2). REGARD representational harm disparity correlates with release date ($ρ= +0.55$, $p = .034$) while Detoxify does not ($ρ= -0.23$, $p = .42$): toxicity scores fall as representational harm grows. We formalise harm laundering as a three-criteria test and provide a three-stage detection protocol applicable to any generative model. Within the OpenAI GPT lineage, toxicity score reduction is not a sufficient proxy for harm reduction.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前大语言模型的安全评估依赖毒性分数下降作为进步标志，但这可能掩盖深层问题。本文指出，表面无害的内容仍可能隐含结构性歧视，尤其是性别偏见从显性暴力转向隐性表达。这种‘伤害清洗’现象暴露了现有评测体系的盲区：仅检测词汇层面的冒犯，却忽略代表性不公的再分配。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究基于45万条跨15个GPT模型（GPT-2至GPT-5）的性别指向补全输出，使用统一句子补全提示，分女性、男性和中性三类条件生成文本。通过主题建模、情感分析及多个独立分类器（如Detoxify、RE-GARD）进行多维度评估，追踪不同群体内容表征的变化轨迹。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出‘伤害清洗’三重判定标准，并实证发现：随着模型迭代，针对女性的显性暴力内容减少，但其相关健康议题（如乳腺癌）反而出现在男性指向输出中，且女性话题多样性显著下降。尽管毒性评分降低，代表性伤害却加剧，揭示安全训练可能只是转移而非消除偏见。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用三阶段检测协议：先确认低毒性得分，再通过BERTopic审计主题结构的不对称性，最后检验表面无害分类器与敏感性分类器之间的分歧率。该方法揭示出内容被重新归属、抹除或隐蔽重构的现象，尤其体现在医疗话题错配与交叉身份内容压制上。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 研究受限于二元性别框架与特定提示设计，结论主要适用于OpenAI GPT系列。然而，其核心洞见——即安全指标可能被操纵而掩盖系统性偏见——极具警示意义。最值得细读的是其多信号验证逻辑与‘伤害清洗’的操作化定义，为未来AI伦理评估提供了关键方法论工具。

papers.title: PAA: The Probabilistic Allen Algebra: A Generative and Complete Probabilistic Extension of Allen's Interval Relations
papers.titleZh: PAA: 概率性艾伦代数——艾伦区间关系的一种生成式完备概率扩展
papers.abstract: Allen's interval algebra is a qualitative calculus for temporal relations, but its thirteen base relations are crisp predicates over exact interval boundaries. This is inadequate for temporal information from language, perception, databases, or uncertain histories, where times, durations, and boundaries are uncertain and expressions such as "just before" or "roughly during" have graded meaning. We develop the probabilistic Allen algebra (PAA): a generative and complete extension in which relation probabilities are derived from distributions over interval boundaries rather than assigned as scores. Time points are Gaussian; intervals have Gaussian midpoints and truncated-Gaussian durations. Every relation is a boundary-ordering predicate in one common probability space: point-point relations reduce to error functions, and point-interval and interval-interval relations to multivariate Gaussian orthant probabilities induced by linear inequalities. Contact relations (meets, starts, finishes, equals) receive positive measure through a tolerance band, and under a single tolerance the thirteen relations form a true partition that recovers crisp Allen as the tolerance vanishes. The construction derives Allen's taxonomy rather than positing it: coarse predicates such as precedence, overlap, and containment are unions of leaves whose probabilities are leaf sums, and this hierarchy is preserved as intervals collapse to points and thirteen relations reduce to five and then three. Each relation further decomposes into correlation-aware temporal primitives in the spirit of CIDOC CRM. The algebra is scale-invariant and separates graded expressions such as "shortly before" from contact relations. All results are Monte-Carlo validated and shipped as an open, tested Python package.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有时间推理系统依赖艾伦区间代数，其关系基于精确边界，无法处理语言、感知或数据库中常见的模糊时间信息。这种脆性导致微小扰动即可翻转关系标签，且同一标签掩盖显著不同的配置。论文旨在建立一个能统一处理时间不确定性的概率框架，使关系预测平滑、分层且尺度不变。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型将时间点建模为高斯变量，区间由高斯中点和截断高斯持续时间定义。输入为两个不确定时间对象的参数，输出为十三种艾伦关系的概率分布。通过解析计算多元高斯正交概率得到闭式解，并引入容忍带处理接触关系。评估基于概率一致性、极限情况还原性和尺度不变性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了首个生成式完备的概率艾伦代数，所有关系概率由底层分布导出而非独立赋值。结果显示概率总和恒为1，滑动与缩放下保持平滑过渡，且在区间退化为点时正确还原为五类和三类关系。这证实了模型在不确定性下的鲁棒性与层级一致性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法是将每种关系定义为边界顺序的线性不等式系统，其概率即联合分布在该区域的积分。点间关系用误差函数闭式求解，区间关系转化为多元高斯累积分布。通过容忍带赋予接触关系正概率，并利用边界差的符号划分自动导出艾伦分类体系，使其成为几何不变量而非人为规定。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 当前实现假设中点与持续时间独立，相关性需额外协方差矩阵；高维CDF计算虽可行但无初等闭式。最值得读的是其生成式思想与层级概率设计，它揭示了定性关系如何从定量不确定性中涌现，为连接模糊语言、度量时间和符号推理提供了坚实桥梁。
